metadata.source: same read snapshot: current user ID/content/session/revision and runtime attribution; no general coreference assertion
metadata.capabilities: actual current REGISTRY declarations, not runtime readiness
metadata.receipts: empty for ordinary reply generation only, not historical non-execution proof
metadata.private_data: no raw user source, contacts, reminder titles or new persistent storage

privacy_gate: Validate source before prompt and after full message assembly; observed revision/source mismatch raises Cancelled before native reply request. Does not retroactively erase analysis or historical provider requests.
failure_policy: Retain raw failures; new version/freeze for each candidate. No production factory installation or final rewriting.
review: Source spans and actual side effects; agent review is not independent human evaluation.
